root_cause.text: Using the `__cleanup(kfree)` attribute on a local pointer variable causes `kfree` to be invoked on the stack address of the variable itself instead of the heap-allocated memory returned by `kzalloc`, resulting in an invalid free and crash.

The CVE description explicitly states that `__cleanup(kfree)` passes the address of the local variable to `kfree` rather than the allocated pointer, leading to invalid deallocation of a stack address.

    crypto: ccp - reduce stack usage in ccp_run_aes_gcm_cmd
